run_f_gold: run f_gold to count words that appear exactly two times in an array of strings
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample inputs to verify correct counting of words appearing exactly twice
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a dictionary to count string frequencies and returns words appearing exactly twice
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the dictionary-based frequency counting approach for finding duplicate words
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary for counting word frequencies
